name: skills-pack
description: Ten practical Claude Code skills for everyday development work. Git workflow: draft commit messages from a staged diff, generate changelog entries from commits since the last tag, write PR descriptions, and find the commit that introduced a regression via bisect. Testing: locate untested code paths ranked by risk, diagnose why a test is flaky rather than retrying it, and build characterization tests before refactoring. Code quality: triage TODO/FIXME comments, audit user-facing error messages, and find logging that leaks secrets or buries signal.
